DECIDED

Colour: the dark direction. The warm amber variant is deleted, not parked.

The recording: moved out of the slot under the hero and down below the four primitives, at a size that does not compete. The reader never runs these commands — their agent does — so it is evidence, not the pitch. Its caption now says that outright.

PLAYBACK — still two things to fix.

The label says 00:41 but playback defaults to 20s.

The pacing is a weight table rather than the cast's real frame timings, so the content is genuine while the rhythm is invented. Driving it from demo.cast's 27 timestamps fixes both at once.

Mechanism is sound: reveals on scroll, hidden by JS not CSS (so JS-off shows everything), honours reduced-motion, fails open twice.

OPEN

• Nine H2 sections. Principle 5 says the smallness of the model is the pitch; nine argues the opposite. At least one should come out — the rendezvous section is the weakest, since it describes a coordination gap rather than a capability.

• If the human never watches the terminal, the viewer is the surface they DO look at. It may deserve more room than it has.

• pyproject says 2.3.0, README says pre-1.0. The page prints both.
